q15: Per the AccessorOp source/description: d (current data row), i (row index), data (all rows), op() (function to access operators), sequenceTime (timeline position), frame (current frame), totalFrames (total frames), sequence (timeline metadata), plus utility globals like d3 and turf.
q16: MapStyleOp was removed (schema migration 014-remove-map-style-op). It was a pass-through node exposing a preset map style URL; the migration deletes MapStyleOp nodes and inlines their mapStyle URL value onto the connected MaplibreBasemapOp's mapStyle input (falling back to CARTO_DARK if no value), removing the node and its edges.
q17: Migration 006 renamed the Theatre timeline sheet ID in timeline.sheetsById from 'Nodes' to 'Noodles' (preserving all other timeline state); it did not rename any operator nodes.
q19: Migration 013 added time-markers support to the timeline: it initializes an empty markers array (sequence.markers = []) on the timeline's Noodles sheet sequence for projects that lack one.
q23: NOODLES_VERSION is computed as the max migration number, which is currently 14 (highest migration file is 014). Note: AGENTS.md text says version 6, but the code's actual current version is 14.
q24: '@/' is the projectScheme prefix meaning the path is relative to the project's data directory (project assets); FileOp reads such URLs from the current project's assets.
q25: Unix-style fully qualified paths, e.g. '/my-node' at root or '/container/child' for nested nodes.
q27: The sibling operator in the same container as the current operator.
q28: By an absolute path that includes the container, e.g. '/analysis/filter' (or '/container/child').
